EmailTemplate.description: Sent to an executive's contact when the CP Manager approves the executive a channel head added on the Partner Portal: access under the channel head, without dates of its own.
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Executive Access Approved
EmailTemplate.subject: Your John Keells Properties Partner Portal access is approved
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.Name},
John Keells Properties has approved your access to the Partner Portal as an executive of {!Account.Channel_Head__c}.
HOW YOUR ACCESS WORKS - You work on the projects your channel partner has assigned to you. - Your access has no dates of its own: it continues for as long as your channel partner's access to the Partner Portal does. - Your channel partner holds the contract with John Keells Properties.
NEXT STEP Look for a second email from us, "Welcome to the John Keells Properties Partner Portal". It has your username and a link to set your password. If you cannot find it, check your spam folder.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
